title: Wormhole: $10M bounty offer
segments: This is the Wormhole Deployer:
present you a bug bounty of $10 million for exploit details, and returning the wETH
You can reach out to us at [contact redacted]
context: Wormhole (Feb 2022, about $326M). The first on-chain bounty offer, $10M, never taken up.
role_evidence: Weakest role evidence: the message self-identifies as the Wormhole Deployer; dataset class 'unknown'; the address 0x96d13cbe... was not independently tied to Wormhole here.
text_match_note: exact on the full text, which contains a raw 0x19 control byte where an apostrophe was intended ('We<0x19>d like'); excerpts avoid it

title: Wintermute: 'Stay Optimistic!'
segments: Hello, Vitalik, I believe in you, just want to know your opinion on this.
And hello Wintermute, sorry, I only have 18M and this is what I can return.
Stay Optimistic!
context: Wintermute / Optimism (Jun 2022). The exploiter's note to Vitalik and Wintermute, posted on Optimism, alongside a partial return.
role_evidence: Recipient 0xd8da6bf2... is the well-known vitalik.eth address. Attacker class from dataset coding only; no paired message; return amount not verified here.

title: Euler: $1M arrest-reward ultimatum
segments: Following up on our message from yesterday. If 90% of the funds are not returned within 24 hours, tomorrow we will launch a $1M reward for information that leads to your arrest and the return of all funds.
context: Euler Finance. The project's ultimatum: 90% back in 24 hours or a $1M reward for information leading to arrest.
role_evidence: Sender is the project-coded address 0xee009faf...; two-way pairing with the attacker reply verified.

title: Euler: 'No intention of keeping what is not ours'
segments: We want to make this easy on all those affected. No intention of keeping what is not ours. Setting up secure communication. Let us come to an agreement.
context: Euler Finance (Mar 2023, about $197M). First attacker reply, nearly 6 days after the project's $1M-reward ultimatum.
role_evidence: Two-way pairing verified against the project's first message (0x539c6fff...). Euler's returns were not re-verified on-chain here.

title: KyberSwap Elastic: the exploiter's 'treaty'
segments: A small error was made, rounding in the wrong direction, it could have been made by anyone.
I require my demands to be met by December 10, otherwise, the treaty falls through.
- Kyber Director
context: KyberSwap Elastic (Nov 2023). The exploiter's 'treaty' demands control of the company and the DAO instead of a bounty.
role_evidence: Sender 0x50275e0b... is the address KyberSwap's outreach messages (0xcd34182974..., 0xfeb8bd9132...) were addressed to; consistent with the exploiter replying, not independently labelled.
text_match_note: exact substrings of a 2,658-char message. The case-table paraphrase 'temporary complete control of KyberDAO' is NOT verbatim: the chain says 'Temporary full authority and ownership over the governance mechanism (KyberDAO)' and separately 'Complete executive control over Kyber (the company)'

title: Rho Markets: 'admit that it was not an exploit'
segments: Hello RHO team, our MEV bot have profited from your price oracle misconfiguration.
But first we would like you to admit that it was not an exploit or a hack, but a misconfiguration on your end.
context: Rho Markets (Jul 2024). An MEV operator offers to 'fully return' the funds, but only if the protocol admits it was a misconfiguration and not a hack.
role_evidence: Weaker role evidence: attacker class from dataset coding only; no paired message in this set.

title: Shezmu: 20% counter-offer
segments:
Hi there - thanks for reaching out. Sure we can talk about the refund, but only considering 20% as bounty.
btw I have no problem with that KYC.
context: Shezmu (Sep 2024, about $4.9M). The exploiter counters the project's 10% offer, which had threatened a KYC-link report, with 20%, 3h52m after the offer.
role_evidence: Reply pairing verified: the sender 0xfaf2484a... is the addressee of Shezmu's offer (0x3e3b04aa...) and replies to that offer's sender.
text_match_note: exact on the text (the dataset CSV had flattened the line break)

title: Shezmu: '20% is a deal'
segments: 20% is a deal. Please send the funds to our treasury: 0xA004e4ceDea8497d6f028463e6756a5e6296bAd3 thank you for your cooperation
context: Shezmu. The project accepts the 20% counter 5m12s later (02:15:47 to 02:20:59 UTC). The same treasury address received 137 WETH and 9,346 DAI from the exploiter's address; the full return was not verified.
role_evidence: Two-way pairing with the exploiter's reply verified; the message names the same treasury address that the first offer named. Project identity otherwise rests on dataset coding.

title: Makina: 10% Safe Harbor offer to an MEV builder
segments: we offer up to a 10% bounty for funds rescued by WhiteHats
Or if anonymity is preferred please return 920.7 ETH directly to 0x62244C74e1d09b3D86EF7342d354b5D7770bDE10 to settle this matter.
context: Makina (Jan 2026, about $4.2M). Safe Harbor-style offer to the MEV builder that received 1,023 ETH. 51h47m later the builder returns exactly 920.7 ETH, leaving 102.3 ETH (exactly 10%). Both txs verified.
role_evidence: The message recipient (0xbed26250...) is the address that received the 1,023 ETH and sent the 920.7 ETH return. Project-side sender identity is dataset coding only.
text_match_note: close: identical to the decoded calldata except line breaks and spacing; the excerpts are exact substrings

title: Verus: 1,350 ETH bounty offer
segments: We will also post a public acknowledgement, referencing the 1350 ETH and publicly state that we consider those funds to be your bounty.
context: Verus-Ethereum bridge (May 2026). Offer of a 1,350 ETH bounty for return of the rest. 5h34m later 4,052 ETH arrives at the address named in the offer; 3 minutes after that 1,350 ETH moves to a separate address that still held exactly 1,350 ETH when queried on 21 Oct 2026.
role_evidence: The offer was addressed to 0x65cb8b12..., the same address that sent the 4,052 ETH return and the 1,350 ETH transfer. Offer sender (0xd498061f...) has dataset class 'unknown'.
text_match_note: exact substring. The press-sourced quote in negotiation_cases_public.csv has '1,350 ETH'; the chain text says '1350 ETH'

title: ChainConnect: one-line acceptance
segments: I accept the proposal as a whitehat. Please contact me via Blockscan Chat to discuss the details.
context: ChainConnect bridge exploit (26 Jul 2026, about $650k). The exploiter accepts the project's offer in one line and about 14 hours later returns 280 ETH (return tx verified).
role_evidence: Strongest role evidence in the set. The sender (0xd86cbc18...) is the address that later sends the 280 ETH return and is the address ChainConnect's confirmation message calls 'the controller'; two-way message pairing with the project address 0x68d447e2... verified.

title: Liquid Network: 'You SHALL pay 10%'
segments: You SHALL pay 10% using your own money as bug bounty or you will cause all your holders a 15% loss
context: Liquid Network / Blockstream (Sep 2026). After a first OP_RETURN note 'we are whitehats. contact us on chain' (tx c103de95..., 2026-09-06, exact), the same address demands that Blockstream pay a 10% bounty from its own money (2026-09-09).
role_evidence: Both txs spend from the same bitcoin address (bc1ql4mfu6...). That this address is the exploiter rests on TRM's attribution, not on chain data.
text_match_note: exact substring of the OP_RETURN text. The case table cites the first tx (c103de95...) for this quote, but that tx holds only the 'we are whitehats' line; the 'SHALL pay 10%' text is in f7055f6c...
